title: Grilled Fiordilatte with Croatian Spicy Sausage and Yellow Peppers
description: A simple and flavorful summer recipe featuring grilled Fiordilatte cheese, Croatian spicy sausage, and yellow peppers.
instructions: Thread Croatian spicy sausage, yellow pepper, and onion onto skewers.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until sausage is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Meanwhile, grill Fiordilatte cheese rounds for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and slightly charred.
Serve skewers with grilled cheese and garnish with chopped parsley.
